answer: Try GPU attestation quotas. First, each agent runs on an NVIDIA H100 in confidential-computing mode, and the card signs a report with its factory key. Second, the ledger binds that key to one identity, so a card registered as sparrow-07 can't come back as juniper-12. Third, every epoch it must sign a fresh nonce within 90 seconds, proving the card is live and not borrowed. A sybil wanting 100 seats needs 100 H100s, about $2.5M bought or roughly $250 an hour rented, nonstop. Faking it is like shouting into a canyon and hoping the echo gets counted as a second voice.
